svg.title: Competitions and innovation workflow
svg.desc: The main route covers all 6 stages. Decision nodes state when to continue; side branches show where to return if conditions are not met. Solid arrows move downwards, gold diamonds are decisions, and dashed lines return after correction.Plan registration independently around the official window. Registration and prototyping may overlap or occur in a different order under the rules; do not miss a deadline while awaiting an internal milestone. Each restricted activity still requires its formal prerequisites. This diagram guides the work; official decisions determine eligibility and results.
